reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that integrates official OAuth and client sessions from multiple AI providers into a shared account pool, with provider-native requests, model metadata, quota status, and account selection policies.

summaries.zh: Dockyard DSH 将多个 AI 服务商的官方 OAuth 和客户端会话接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供统一的账号池、模型目录、额度状态及请求适配。
summaries.en: Dockyard DSH connects official OAuth and client sessions from multiple AI providers to DeepSeek Harness with shared account management, model and quota metadata, and provider-native request adapters.

capabilities: Opens official provider OAuth authorization flows
Scans existing local provider client or CLI sessions
Stores provider refresh tokens in OS credential storage
Manages multiple provider accounts with selection and failover policies
Reads live provider model, plan, and quota metadata
